3. Calcium (\(\mathrm{Ca}\)) forms calcium oxalate (\(\mathrm{CaC_2O_4}\)), which is insoluble in water.
4. Barium (\(\mathrm{Ba}\), atomic number 56) belongs to Group 2 and Period 6, so its outer electronic configuration is \(6s^2\). Additionally, barium sulphate (\(\mathrm{BaSO_4}\)) is insoluble in water because the hydration enthalpy of the large \(\mathrm{Ba}^{2+}\) ion is insufficient to overcome the lattice enthalpy of \(\mathrm{BaSO_4}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, \(\mathrm{Li}\) corresponds to the most negative \(E^\ominus\) value among alkali metals, \(\mathrm{Na}\) corresponds to the strongest monoacidic base, \(\mathrm{Ca}\) corresponds to an insoluble oxalate, and \(\mathrm{Ba}\) corresponds to both an insoluble sulphate and a \(6s^2\) outer electronic configuration.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
s-ब्लॉक तत्वों के गुणधर्म उनकी परमाण्विक/आयनिक त्रिज्या, जलयोजन एन्थैल्पी, जालक एन्थैल्पी तथा संयोजी कोश के इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास पर निर्भर करते हैं।

चरण 2: प्रत्येक तत्व का मूल्यांकन
1. लीथियम (\(\mathrm{Li}\)) की आयनिक त्रिज्या क्षार धातुओं में सबसे छोटी होती है, जिसके कारण इसकी जलयोजन एन्थैल्पी अत्यधिक उच्च होती है। यह इसकी उच्च आयनन एन्थैल्पी की क्षतिपूर्ति करती है और इसे क्षार धातुओं में सर्वाधिक ऋणात्मक मानक इलेक्ट्रोड विभव (\(E^\ominus = -3.04\text{ V}\)) प्रदान करती है।
2. सोडियम (\(\mathrm{Na}\)) सोडियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड (\(\mathrm{NaOH}\)) बनाता है, जो एक अत्यंत प्रबल एकअम्लीय क्षारक के रूप में कार्य करता है।
3. कैल्सियम (\(\mathrm{Ca}\)) कैल्सियम ऑक्सैलेट (\(\mathrm{CaC_2O_4}\)) बनाता है, जो जल में अविलेय होता है।
4. बेरियम (\(\mathrm{Ba}\), परमाणु क्रमांक 56) वर्ग 2 तथा आवर्त 6 से संबंधित है, अतः इसका बाह्य इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास \(6s^2\) है। इसके अतिरिक्त, बेरियम सल्फेट (\(\mathrm{BaSO_4}\)) जल में अविलेय होता है क्योंकि बड़े \(\mathrm{Ba}^{2+}\) आयन की जलयोजन एन्थैल्पी \(\mathrm{BaSO_4}\) की जालक एन्थैल्पी को पार करने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं होती।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः \(\mathrm{Li}\) क्षार धातुओं में सर्वाधिक ऋणात्मक \(E^\ominus\) मान से, \(\mathrm{Na}\) प्रबलतम एकअम्लीय क्षारक से, \(\mathrm{Ca}\) अविलेय ऑक्सैलेट से तथा \(\mathrm{Ba}\) अविलेय सल्फेट और \(6s^2\) बाह्य इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास दोनों से सुमेलित है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_2025_SEC4_THESBLOCKELEMENTS_MATCHING_Q42 - Calcium compounds and their industrial uses

questiontext.text:
Match the compounds given in Column I with their uses mentioned in Column II.

कॉलम I में दिए गए यौगिकों को कॉलम II में उल्लिखित उनके उपयोगों से सुमेलित कीजिए।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Important compounds of calcium have specific industrial and commercial applications based on their chemical reactivity, basicity, and physical properties.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Compound
1. Calcium carbonate (\(\mathrm{CaCO_3}\)) is used in the manufacture of high-quality paper as a filler and coating pigment.
2. Calcium hydroxide (\(\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}\), slaked lime) is used in white washing due to its disinfectant nature and reaction with atmospheric \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) to form a shiny layer of \(\mathrm{CaCO_3}\).
3. Calcium oxide (\(\mathrm{CaO}\), quicklime) is used in the manufacture of sodium carbonate from caustic soda.
4. Calcium sulphate (\(\mathrm{CaSO_4}\), in the form of Plaster of Paris, \(\mathrm{CaSO_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}H_2O}\)) is used in dentistry and ornamental work.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Thus, \(\mathrm{CaCO_3}\) is used in the manufacture of high quality paper, \(\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}\) is used in white washing, \(\mathrm{CaO}\) is used in the manufacture of sodium carbonate from caustic soda, and \(\mathrm{CaSO_4}\) is used in dentistry and ornamental work.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
कैल्सियम के महत्वपूर्ण यौगिकों के विशिष्ट औद्योगिक एवं व्यावसायिक उपयोग उनकी रासायनिक क्रियाशीलता, क्षारीयता और भौतिक गुणों पर आधारित होते हैं।

चरण 2: प्रत्येक यौगिक का मूल्यांकन
1. कैल्सियम कार्बोनेट (\(\mathrm{CaCO_3}\)) का उपयोग उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले कागज के निर्माण में किया जाता है।
2. कैल्सियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड (\(\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}\), बुझा हुआ चूना) का उपयोग सफेदी करने (पुताई) में किया जाता है क्योंकि यह रोगाणुनाशी होता है और वायुमंडलीय \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) से अभिक्रिया करके \(\mathrm{CaCO_3}\) की चमकदार परत बनाता है।
3. कैल्सियम ऑक्साइड (\(\mathrm{CaO}\), बिना बुझा चूना) का उपयोग कॉस्टिक सोडा से सोडियम कार्बोनेट के निर्माण में किया जाता है।
4. कैल्सियम सल्फेट (\(\mathrm{CaSO_4}\), प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस \(\mathrm{CaSO_4 \cdot \frac{1}{2}H_2O}\) के रूप में) का उपयोग दंत चिकित्सा और सजावटी कार्यों में किया जाता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
इस प्रकार, \(\mathrm{CaCO_3}\) का उपयोग उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले कागज के निर्माण में, \(\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}\) का उपयोग सफेदी करने में, \(\mathrm{CaO}\) का उपयोग कॉस्टिक सोडा से सोडियम कार्बोनेट के निर्माण में, तथा \(\mathrm{CaSO_4}\) का उपयोग दंत चिकित्सा एवं सजावटी कार्यों में होता है।

answer.text: Manufacture of sodium carbonate from caustic soda

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_2025_SEC4_THESBLOCKELEMENTS_MATCHING_Q43 - Alkali and alkaline earth flame colours

questiontext.text:
Match the elements given in Column I with the colour they impart to the flame given in Column II.

कॉलम I में दिए गए तत्वों को कॉलम II में दिए गए उनके द्वारा ज्वाला को प्रदान किए जाने वाले रंग से सुमेलित कीजिए।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When alkali and alkaline earth metals (except \(\mathrm{Be}\) and \(\mathrm{Mg}\)) or their salts are heated in an oxidising flame, the valence electrons are excited to higher energy levels. When these electrons return to the ground state, they emit radiation in the visible region, imparting characteristic colours to the flame.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Element
1. Caesium (\(\mathrm{Cs}\)) imparts a blue colour to the flame.
2. Sodium (\(\mathrm{Na}\)) imparts a yellow colour to the flame.
3. Potassium (\(\mathrm{K}\)) imparts a violet (lilac) colour to the flame.
4. Calcium (\(\mathrm{Ca}\)) imparts a brick red colour to the flame.
5. Strontium (\(\mathrm{Sr}\)) imparts a crimson red colour to the flame.
6. Barium (\(\mathrm{Ba}\)) imparts an apple green colour to the flame.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The characteristic flame colours are: \(\mathrm{Cs}\) – blue, \(\mathrm{Na}\) – yellow, \(\mathrm{K}\) – violet, \(\mathrm{Ca}\) – brick red, \(\mathrm{Sr}\) – crimson red, and \(\mathrm{Ba}\) – apple green.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
जब क्षार और क्षारीय मृदा धातुओं (\(\mathrm{Be}\) तथा \(\mathrm{Mg}\) को छोड़कर) या उनके लवणों को ऑक्सीकारक ज्वाला में गर्म किया जाता है, तो संयोजी इलेक्ट्रॉन उच्च ऊर्जा स्तरों में उत्तेजित हो जाते हैं। जब ये इलेक्ट्रॉन मूल अवस्था में लौटते हैं, तो वे दृश्य क्षेत्र में विकिरण उत्सर्जित करते हैं, जिससे ज्वाला को विशिष्ट रंग प्राप्त होता है।

चरण 2: प्रत्येक तत्व का मूल्यांकन
1. सीज़ियम (\(\mathrm{Cs}\)) ज्वाला को नीला (Blue) रंग प्रदान करता है।
2. सोडियम (\(\mathrm{Na}\)) ज्वाला को पीला (Yellow) रंग प्रदान करता है।
3. पोटैशियम (\(\mathrm{K}\)) ज्वाला को बैंगनी (Violet) रंग प्रदान करता है।
4. कैल्सियम (\(\mathrm{Ca}\)) ज्वाला को ईंट जैसा लाल (Brick red) रंग प्रदान करता है।
5. स्ट्रॉन्शियम (\(\mathrm{Sr}\)) ज्वाला को किरमिजी लाल (Crimson red) रंग प्रदान करता है।
6. बेरियम (\(\mathrm{Ba}\)) ज्वाला को सेब जैसा हरा (Apple green) रंग प्रदान करता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
ज्वाला के विशिष्ट रंग इस प्रकार हैं: \(\mathrm{Cs}\) – नीला, \(\mathrm{Na}\) – पीला, \(\mathrm{K}\) – बैंगनी, \(\mathrm{Ca}\) – ईंट जैसा लाल, \(\mathrm{Sr}\) – किरमिजी लाल, तथा \(\mathrm{Ba}\) – सेब जैसा हरा।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_2025_SEC5_THESBLOCKELEMENTS_ASSERTIONREASON_Q44 - Thermal decomposition of lithium carbonate

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): The carbonate of lithium decomposes easily on heating to form lithium oxide and \(\mathrm{CO_2}\).

Reason (R): Lithium being very small in size polarises large carbonate ion leading to the formation of more stable \(\mathrm{Li_2O}\) and \(\mathrm{CO_2}\).

अभिकथन (A): लीथियम का कार्बोनेट गर्म करने पर आसानी से विघटित होकर लीथियम ऑक्साइड तथा \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) बनाता है।

कारण (R): लीथियम का आकार अत्यंत छोटा होने के कारण यह बड़े कार्बोनेट आयन का ध्रुवण करता है, जिससे अधिक स्थायी \(\mathrm{Li_2O}\) और \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) का निर्माण होता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The thermal stability of metal carbonates depends on the polarising power of the metal cation, which increases with increasing charge density (smaller ionic radius for a given charge).

Step 2: Evaluation of the Statements
Unlike the carbonates of other alkali metals, lithium carbonate (\(\mathrm{Li_2CO_3}\)) is thermally unstable and decomposes readily upon heating to yield lithium oxide (\(\mathrm{Li_2O}\)) and carbon dioxide (\(\mathrm{CO_2}\)):
\[\mathrm{Li_2CO_3} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \mathrm{Li_2O} + \mathrm{CO_2}\]
This occurs because the \(\mathrm{Li}^+\) ion is very small and possesses high polarising power. It strongly polarises the large carbonate (\(\mathrm{CO_3^{2-}}\)) ion, distorting its electron cloud and weakening the \(\mathrm{C-O}\) bonds, which facilitates decomposition into the more stable oxide \(\mathrm{Li_2O}\) (which has a high lattice energy with small \(\mathrm{O}^{2-}\)) and \(\mathrm{CO_2}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both statements are correct, and the high polarising power of the small lithium ion directly explains why lithium carbonate decomposes easily on heating.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
धातु कार्बोनेटों का तापीय स्थायित्व धातु धनायन की ध्रुवण क्षमता पर निर्भर करता है, जो आवेश घनत्व बढ़ने (समान आवेश के लिए छोटी आयनिक त्रिज्या) के साथ बढ़ती है।

चरण 2: कथनों का मूल्यांकन
अन्य क्षार धातुओं के कार्बोनेटों के विपरीत, लीथियम कार्बोनेट (\(\mathrm{Li_2CO_3}\)) तापीय रूप से अस्थायी होता है और गर्म करने पर आसानी से विघटित होकर लीथियम ऑक्साइड (\(\mathrm{Li_2O}\)) तथा कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (\(\mathrm{CO_2}\)) देता है:
\[\mathrm{Li_2CO_3} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \mathrm{Li_2O} + \mathrm{CO_2}\]
ऐसा इसलिए होता है क्योंकि \(\mathrm{Li}^+\) आयन का आकार अत्यंत छोटा होता है और इसकी ध्रुवण क्षमता बहुत अधिक होती है। यह बड़े कार्बोनेट (\(\mathrm{CO_3^{2-}}\)) आयन का प्रबलता से ध्रुवण करता है, जिससे उसका इलेक्ट्रॉन अभ्र विकृत हो जाता है और \(\mathrm{C-O}\) बंध दुर्बल हो जाते हैं। इसके फलस्वरूप यह अधिक स्थायी ऑक्साइड \(\mathrm{Li_2O}\) (जिसकी छोटे \(\mathrm{O}^{2-}\) आयन के साथ जालक ऊर्जा उच्च होती है) तथा \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) में विघटित हो जाता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
दोनों कथन सही हैं तथा छोटे लीथियम आयन की उच्च ध्रुवण क्षमता ही लीथियम कार्बोनेट के गर्म करने पर आसानी से विघटित होने की सही व्याख्या करती है।

answer.text: Both A and R are correct and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are correct but R is not the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are not correct
A is not correct but R is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_2025_SEC5_THESBLOCKELEMENTS_ASSERTIONREASON_Q45 - Storage of beryllium carbonate in carbon dioxide

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): Beryllium carbonate is kept in the atmosphere of carbon dioxide.

Reason (R): Beryllium carbonate is unstable and decomposes to give beryllium oxide and carbon dioxide.

अभिकथन (A): बेरीलियम कार्बोनेट को कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के वातावरण में रखा जाता है।

कारण (R): बेरीलियम कार्बोनेट अस्थायी होता है तथा विघटित होकर बेरीलियम ऑक्साइड और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड देता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Group 2 carbonates undergo thermal decomposition according to the reversible equilibrium:
\[\mathrm{MCO_3(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{MO(s)} + \mathrm{CO_2(g)}\]
Due to the very small size and high polarising power of the \(\mathrm{Be}^{2+}\) ion, beryllium carbonate is the least thermally stable among alkaline earth metal carbonates.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Statements
Beryllium carbonate (\(\mathrm{BeCO_3}\)) is unstable even at room temperature and readily decomposes to form beryllium oxide (\(\mathrm{BeO}\)) and carbon dioxide (\(\mathrm{CO_2}\)):
\[\mathrm{BeCO_3(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{BeO(s)} + \mathrm{CO_2(g)}\]
According to Le Chatelier's principle, storing \(\mathrm{BeCO_3}\) in an atmosphere of \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) increases the partial pressure of \(\mathrm{CO_2}\), shifting the equilibrium to the left and preventing its decomposition.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both statements are correct, and the instability and decomposition of beryllium carbonate into beryllium oxide and carbon dioxide correctly explains why it is kept in a carbon dioxide atmosphere.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
वर्ग 2 के कार्बोनेट निम्नलिखित उत्क्रमणीय साम्य के अनुसार तापीय विघटन दर्शाते हैं:
\[\mathrm{MCO_3(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{MO(s)} + \mathrm{CO_2(g)}\]
\(\mathrm{Be}^{2+}\) आयन के अत्यंत छोटे आकार और उच्च ध्रुवण क्षमता के कारण, बेरीलियम कार्बोनेट क्षारीय मृदा धातु कार्बोनेटों में तापीय रूप से सबसे कम स्थायी होता है।

चरण 2: कथनों का मूल्यांकन
बेरीलियम कार्बोनेट (\(\mathrm{BeCO_3}\)) कमरे के ताप पर भी अस्थायी होता है और आसानी से विघटित होकर बेरीलियम ऑक्साइड (\(\mathrm{BeO}\)) तथा कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (\(\mathrm{CO_2}\)) बनाता है:
\[\mathrm{BeCO_3(s)} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{BeO(s)} + \mathrm{CO_2(g)}\]
ल शातेलिए के सिद्धांत के अनुसार, \(\mathrm{BeCO_3}\) को \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) के वातावरण में रखने से \(\mathrm{CO_2}\) का आंशिक दाब बढ़ जाता है, जिससे साम्य बाईं ओर विस्थापित होता है और इसका विघटन रुक जाता है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
दोनों कथन सही हैं तथा बेरीलियम कार्बोनेट का अस्थायी होना और बेरीलियम ऑक्साइड व कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड में विघटित होना ही इसे कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के वातावरण में रखने की सही व्याख्या करता है।

answer.text: Both A and R are correct and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are correct but R is not the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are not correct.
A is not correct but R is correct.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q01 - Element existing in liquid state for high temperature

questiontext.text: The element which exists in liquid state for a wide range of temperature and can be used for measuring high temperature is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Among Group 13 elements, melting point generally decreases down the group with a notable anomaly at gallium due to its unusual crystal structure consisting of discrete \(\mathrm{Ga}_2\) molecules.

Step 2: Evaluation
Gallium (\(\mathrm{Ga}\)) has a very low melting point of about \(303\text{ K}\) (\(29.8\,^\circ\mathrm{C}\)), so it can exist in the liquid state during summer, while its boiling point is extraordinarily high at \(2676\text{ K}\). Boron has a very high melting point, and aluminium and indium have significantly higher melting points than gallium.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Because gallium remains liquid over an exceptionally wide temperature range (\(303\text{ K}\) to \(2676\text{ K}\)), it is used in high-temperature thermometry. Therefore, the correct element is \(\mathrm{Ga}\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q02 - Identifying a Lewis acid among metal chlorides

questiontext.text: Which of the following is a Lewis acid?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to the Lewis concept, a Lewis acid is an electron-pair acceptor. Covalent halides with an incomplete octet around the central atom have a vacant orbital and can accept a lone pair of electrons.

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\), aluminium has only three valence electrons and forms three covalent bonds with chlorine, leaving only \(6\) electrons in its valence shell (an incomplete octet). In contrast, \(\mathrm{MgCl}_2\), \(\mathrm{CaCl}_2\), and \(\mathrm{BaCl}_2\) are predominantly ionic halides of Group 2 elements in which the metal cations have a stable noble-gas octet configuration.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Because aluminium in \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) is electron-deficient and readily accepts an electron pair to complete its octet, \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) acts as a Lewis acid.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q03 - Hybridisation and geometry of tetrahydroxo complex species

questiontext.text: The geometry of a complex species can be understood from the knowledge of type of hybridisation of orbitals of central atom. The hybridisation of orbitals of central atom in \(\left[\mathrm{Be}(\mathrm{OH})_{4}\right]^{-}\) and the geometry of the complex are respectively

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The geometry of a main-group complex with four monodentate ligands and no lone pairs on the central atom is determined by its steric number, which equals the number of \(\sigma\)-bonds formed around the central atom.

Step 2: Evaluation
In the given tetrahydroxo complex species, the central atom is surrounded by four \(\mathrm{OH}^-\) ligands forming four \(\sigma\)-bonds and has no lone pairs of electrons. A steric number of \(4\) corresponds to the mixing of one \(s\) orbital and three \(p\) orbitals, giving \(sp^3\) hybridisation. Four \(sp^3\) hybrid orbitals orient symmetrically in three-dimensional space at bond angles of \(109.5^\circ\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The hybridisation of the central atom is \(sp^3\) and the geometry of the complex is tetrahedral.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q04 - Acidic nature of Group 13 oxides

questiontext.text: Which of the following oxides is acidic in nature?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In Group 13, metallic character increases down the group from boron to thallium. Consequently, the nature of the trioxides changes from acidic to amphoteric and then to basic down the group.

Step 2: Evaluation
Boron is a non-metal, so boron trioxide (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) is purely acidic and reacts with basic oxides or alkalies to form borates. Aluminium oxide (\(\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) and gallium oxide (\(\mathrm{Ga}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) are amphoteric, reacting with both acids and bases. Indium oxide (\(\mathrm{In}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) is basic in nature.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Among the given Group 13 oxides, \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) is acidic in nature.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q05 - Maximum covalency and absence of d-orbitals in boron

questiontext.text: The exhibition of highest co-ordination number depends on the availability of vacant orbitals in the central atom. Which of the following elements is not likely to act as central atom in \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\)?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Forming the octahedral complex ion \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\) requires a coordination number of \(6\), which demands \(sp^3d^2\) hybridisation and thus the availability of vacant \(d\) orbitals in the valence shell of the central atom.

Step 2: Evaluation
Boron (\(\mathrm{B}\)) belongs to the second period (\(n = 2\)), where only one \(2s\) and three \(2p\) orbitals are available. Because \(2d\) orbitals do not exist, boron cannot expand its octet beyond \(8\) electrons and its maximum covalency is restricted to \(4\) (as in \(\mathrm{BF}_4^-\)). On the other hand, \(\mathrm{Al}\), \(\mathrm{Ga}\), and \(\mathrm{In}\) belong to periods \(3\), \(4\), and \(5\) respectively, and possess vacant \(d\) orbitals in their valence shells, enabling them to form \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\) ions.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Due to the non-availability of \(d\) orbitals, boron (\(\mathrm{B}\)) cannot act as the central atom in \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q06 - Acidic behaviour of boric acid in water

questiontext.text: Boric acid is an acid because its molecule

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Boric acid, \(\mathrm{B(OH)}_3\), is a weak monobasic Lewis acid rather than a protonic (Brønsted–Lowry) acid.

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{B(OH)}_3\), the boron atom has only \(6\) valence electrons and an empty \(2p\) orbital. It does not dissociate to give up a replaceable \(\mathrm{H}^+\) ion directly. Instead, in aqueous solution, it accepts an electron pair from a hydroxyl ion (\(\mathrm{OH}^-\)) of a water molecule to form the tetrahedral \(\left[\mathrm{B(OH)}_4\right]^-\) ion, thereby releasing a proton (\(\mathrm{H}^+\)):
\[\mathrm{B(OH)}_3 + 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \longrightarrow \left[\mathrm{B(OH)}_4\right]^- + \mathrm{H}_3\mathrm{O}^+\]

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Boric acid behaves as an acid because its molecule accepts \(\mathrm{OH}^-\) from water, releasing a proton.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q07 - Order of catenation in Group 14 elements

questiontext.text: Catenation i.e., linking of similar atoms depends on size and electronic configuration of atoms. The tendency of catenation in Group 14 elements follows the order:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Catenation is the ability of atoms of the same element to link with one another through covalent bonds to form chains and rings. Its extent depends directly on the strength of the \(\mathrm{M}-\mathrm{M}\) single bond.

Step 2: Evaluation
Down Group 14, atomic size increases and electronegativity decreases, causing the \(\mathrm{M}-\mathrm{M}\) bond enthalpy to decrease sharply from carbon to silicon and then more gradually from silicon to germanium and tin (\(\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{C} = 348\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\), \(\mathrm{Si}-\mathrm{Si} = 297\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\), \(\mathrm{Ge}-\mathrm{Ge} = 260\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\), \(\mathrm{Sn}-\mathrm{Sn} = 240\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\)). Because the \(\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{C}\) bond is exceptionally strong, carbon shows far greater catenation than silicon, while germanium and tin have nearly comparable, weak catenation tendencies.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The tendency of catenation in Group 14 elements follows the order \(\mathrm{C} \gg \mathrm{Si} > \mathrm{Ge} \approx \mathrm{Sn}\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q08 - Controlling chain length of silicone polymers

questiontext.text: Silicon has a strong tendency to form polymers like silicones. The chain length of silicone polymer can be controlled by adding

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Linear silicones are formed by the hydrolysis and condensation of dialkyldichlorosilanes (\(\mathrm{R}_2\mathrm{SiCl}_2\)), which are bifunctional monomers. To terminate the growing chain and control polymer length, a monofunctional chlorosilane is added.

Step 2: Evaluation
Upon hydrolysis, \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) produces \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiOH}\), which contains only one reactive \(-\mathrm{OH}\) group. When \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiOH}\) condenses with the terminal \(-\mathrm{OH}\) group of a growing silicone chain, it caps the chain end with non-reactive methyl groups, preventing further polymerisation. By contrast, \(\mathrm{Me}_2\mathrm{SiCl}_2\) propagates linear chains, \(\mathrm{MeSiCl}_3\) forms cross-linked silicones, and \(\mathrm{Me}_4\mathrm{Si}\) has no hydrolysable chlorine atoms.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The chain length of a silicone polymer can be controlled by adding \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q09 - Order of first ionisation enthalpy in Group 13

questiontext.text: Ionisation enthalpy (\(\Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_1\,\mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)) for the elements of Group 13 follows the order.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Ionisation enthalpy generally decreases down a group as atomic size increases, but in Group 13 the presence of poorly shielding inner \(d\) and \(f\) electrons causes significant deviations from a smooth decrease.

Step 2: Evaluation
From \(\mathrm{B}\) to \(\mathrm{Al}\), atomic size increases, so \(\Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_1\) decreases. From \(\mathrm{Al}\) to \(\mathrm{Ga}\), the filling of \(3d\) orbitals introduces poor nuclear shielding, increasing the effective nuclear charge and making \(\Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{Ga}) > \Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{Al})\). From \(\mathrm{Ga}\) to \(\mathrm{In}\), the increase in atomic size outweighs the effect of \(4d\) electrons, so \(\Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_1\) decreases. Finally, from \(\mathrm{In}\) to \(\mathrm{Tl}\), the filling of \(4f\) orbitals causes poor shielding (lanthanoid contraction), sharply raising the effective nuclear charge so that \(\Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{Tl}) > \Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_1(\mathrm{In})\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The first ionisation enthalpy of Group 13 elements follows the order \(\mathrm{B} > \mathrm{Al} < \mathrm{Ga} > \mathrm{In} < \mathrm{Tl}\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q10 - Planar and perpendicular arrangement of atoms in diborane

questiontext.text: In the structure of diborane

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Diborane (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\)) has a bridged structure in which each boron atom is \(sp^3\) hybridised and bonded to two terminal hydrogen atoms and two bridging hydrogen atoms.

Step 2: Evaluation
The two boron atoms and the four terminal hydrogen atoms lie in one common plane, forming four regular two-centre two-electron (\(2c\text{--}2e\)) \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds. The remaining two bridging hydrogen atoms lie one above and one below this plane, forming two three-centre two-electron (\(3c\text{--}2e\)) \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}-\mathrm{B}\) banana bonds in a plane perpendicular to the plane of the boron and terminal hydrogen atoms.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
In diborane, \(2\) boron atoms and \(4\) terminal hydrogen atoms lie in the same plane and \(2\) bridging hydrogen atoms lie in the perpendicular plane.

answer.text: All hydrogen atoms lie in one plane and boron atoms lie in a plane perpendicular to this plane.
\(2\) boron atoms and \(4\) terminal hydrogen atoms lie in the same plane and \(2\) bridging hydrogen atoms lie in the perpendicular plane.
\(4\) bridging hydrogen atoms and boron atoms lie in one plane and two terminal hydrogen atoms lie in a plane perpendicular to this plane.
All the atoms are in the same plane.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q11 - Preparation of diborane and borazine inorganic benzene

questiontext.text: A compound \(\mathrm{X}\), of boron reacts with \(\mathrm{NH}_3\) on heating to give another compound \(\mathrm{Y}\) which is called inorganic benzene. The compound \(\mathrm{X}\) can be prepared by treating \(\mathrm{BF}_3\) with Lithium aluminium hydride. The compounds \(\mathrm{X}\) and \(\mathrm{Y}\) are represented by the formulas.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Boron trifluoride undergoes hydride reduction with \(\mathrm{LiAlH}_4\) to form diborane, which further reacts with ammonia at elevated temperature to yield borazine, commonly known as inorganic benzene.

Step 2: Evaluation
Treating \(\mathrm{BF}_3\) with \(\mathrm{LiAlH}_4\) in diethyl ether produces diborane (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\)) as compound \(\mathrm{X}\):
\[4\mathrm{BF}_3 + 3\mathrm{LiAlH}_4 \longrightarrow 2\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6 + 3\mathrm{LiF} + 3\mathrm{AlF}_3\]
Heating diborane with ammonia yields borazine (\(\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6\)) as compound \(\mathrm{Y}\), which has a cyclic hexagonal structure isoelectronic and isostructural with benzene:
\[3\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6 + 6\mathrm{NH}_3 \xrightarrow{\Delta} 2\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6 + 12\mathrm{H}_2\]

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Compounds \(\mathrm{X}\) and \(\mathrm{Y}\) are \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\) and \(\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6\), respectively.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q12 - Element present in piezoelectric quartz

questiontext.text: Quartz is extensively used as a piezoelectric material, it contains

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Quartz is a crystalline form of silica (silicon dioxide, \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\)) with a three-dimensional covalent network of \(\mathrm{SiO}_4\) tetrahedra.

Step 2: Evaluation
Because quartz is composed of \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\), its constituent elements are silicon (\(\mathrm{Si}\)) and oxygen (\(\mathrm{O}\)). It does not contain lead (\(\mathrm{Pb}\)), titanium (\(\mathrm{Ti}\)), or tin (\(\mathrm{Sn}\)).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Quartz contains silicon (\(\mathrm{Si}\)).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q13 - Commonly used reducing agent among chlorides

questiontext.text: The most commonly used reducing agent is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A reducing agent undergoes oxidation by losing electrons to attain a more stable higher oxidation state. In Group 14, the stability of the \(+4\) oxidation state relative to \(+2\) is high for tin (\(\mathrm{Sn}\)), whereas for lead (\(\mathrm{Pb}\)) the \(+2\) state is more stable due to the inert pair effect.

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\), tin is in the \(+2\) oxidation state and readily loses two electrons to form the more stable \(+4\) oxidation state (\(\mathrm{Sn}^{4+}\)), making \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\) a strong and widely used reducing agent. In \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) and \(\mathrm{SnCl}_4\), the central atoms are already in their maximum oxidation states (\(+3\) and \(+4\)) and cannot be oxidised further. In \(\mathrm{PbCl}_2\), \(\mathrm{Pb}^{2+}\) is already more stable than \(\mathrm{Pb}^{4+}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The most commonly used reducing agent among the given compounds is \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q14 - Chemical identity of dry ice

questiontext.text: Dry ice is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Dry ice is the common name for solidified carbon dioxide, which sublimes directly from the solid phase to the gas phase at atmospheric pressure without melting into a liquid.

Step 2: Evaluation
Because solid carbon dioxide (\(\mathrm{CO}_2\)) turns directly into gas upon warming without leaving any wet liquid residue, it is called dry ice and is widely used as a refrigerant. Solid \(\mathrm{NH}_3\), solid \(\mathrm{SO}_2\), and solid \(\mathrm{N}_2\) are not known as dry ice.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Dry ice is solid \(\mathrm{CO}_2\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQI_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q15 - Periodic groups of oxides present in cement

questiontext.text: Cement, the important building material is a mixture of oxides of several elements. Besides calcium, iron and sulphur, oxides of elements of which of the group (s) are present in the mixture?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Portland cement is a complex mixture of calcium silicates and calcium aluminates containing oxides of several main-group and transition elements.

Step 2: Evaluation
The average composition of Portland cement includes \(\mathrm{CaO}\) (\(50\text{--}60\%\)), \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\) (\(20\text{--}25\%\)), \(\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) (\(5\text{--}10\%\)), \(\mathrm{MgO}\) (\(2\text{--}3\%\)), \(\mathrm{Fe}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) (\(1\text{--}2\%\)), and \(\mathrm{SO}_3\) (\(1\text{--}2\%\)). Apart from calcium, iron, and sulphur, cement contains magnesium (Group 2, as \(\mathrm{MgO}\)), aluminium (Group 13, as \(\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)), and silicon (Group 14, as \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\)).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, oxides of elements belonging to groups \(2\), \(13\), and \(14\) are present in cement.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQII_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q16 - Reasons for small atomic radius of gallium

questiontext.text: The reason for small radius of \(\mathrm{Ga}\) compared to \(\mathrm{Al}\) is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Atomic radius is governed by the balance between the addition of new principal electron shells and the effective nuclear charge experienced by the valence electrons.

Step 2: Evaluation
Gallium (\(Z = 31\)) follows the first \(d\)-block transition series, so it has \(10\) inner \(3d\) electrons in addition to its noble-gas core, whereas aluminium (\(Z = 13\)) has only a noble-gas core. Because \(d\) (and \(f\)) orbitals have diffused shapes and poor screening power, the increased nuclear charge in gallium pulls the outer electrons closer to the nucleus, resulting in a smaller atomic radius for \(\mathrm{Ga}\) (\(135\text{ pm}\)) than for \(\mathrm{Al}\) (\(143\text{ pm}\)). The mere presence of higher orbitals or higher atomic number alone would normally increase atomic radius rather than decrease it.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The smaller radius of \(\mathrm{Ga}\) compared to \(\mathrm{Al}\) is due to the poor screening effect of \(d\) and \(f\) orbitals and the resulting increase in nuclear charge.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQII_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q17 - Factors responsible for linear shape of carbon dioxide

questiontext.text: The linear shape of \(\mathrm{CO}_2\) is due to

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The shape of a molecule is determined by the hybridisation of its central atom and the arrangement of \(\sigma\)-bonds around it, while \(\pi\)-bonds lie in planes perpendicular to the \(\sigma\)-bond axis.

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{CO}_2\) (\(\mathrm{O}=\mathrm{C}=\mathrm{O}\)), the central carbon atom forms two \(\sigma\)-bonds with the two oxygen atoms and has no lone pairs, corresponding to \(sp\) hybridisation with a \(180^\circ\) bond angle (linear geometry). The remaining two unhybridised \(2p\) orbitals of carbon overlap sideways with the \(2p\) orbitals of the two oxygen atoms to form two \(p\pi - p\pi\) bonds, maintaining the linear \(\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{O}\) framework.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The linear shape of \(\mathrm{CO}_2\) is due to \(sp\) hybridisation of carbon and \(p\pi - p\pi\) bonding between carbon and oxygen.

answer.text: \(p\pi - p\pi\) bonding between carbon and oxygen

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQII_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q18 - Role of trimethylchlorosilane in organosilicone polymerisation

questiontext.text: \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) is used during polymerisation of organo silicones because

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Organosilicone polymers are produced by the condensation polymerisation of silanols derived from chlorosilanes. Monofunctional silanes act as chain-terminating agents.

Step 2: Evaluation
Hydrolysis of \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) gives \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiOH}\), which possesses only one reactive hydroxyl group. When it condenses with the terminal \(-\mathrm{OH}\) group of a growing silicone chain, it blocks the end terminal of the silicone polymer because the three methyl groups cannot undergo further condensation. In this way, adding \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) controls the chain length of the organosilicone polymer. It does not act as a catalyst.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
\(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) is used during polymerisation because the chain length of organo silicone polymers can be controlled by adding \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) and \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) blocks the end terminal of the silicone polymer.

answer.text: the chain length of organo silicone polymers can be controlled by adding \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\)
\(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) blocks the end terminal of silicone polymer
\(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) improves the quality and yield of the polymer
\(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) acts as a catalyst during polymerisation

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQII_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q19 - Properties of carbon allotropes fullerenes and graphite

questiontext.text: Which of the following statements are correct?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Elemental carbon exists in several allotropic forms, including fullerenes and graphite, each with distinct structures and thermodynamic stabilities.

Step 2: Evaluation
Fullerenes (such as \(\mathrm{C}_{60}\)) are closed, soccer-ball or cage-like molecules in which every carbon atom is \(sp^2\) hybridised and bonded to three other carbons, so they are pure forms of carbon without any dangling bonds. Graphite has a layered \(sp^2\)-hybridised hexagonal sheet structure with delocalised \(\pi\)-electrons, making it the thermodynamically most stable allotrope of carbon (\(\Delta_{\mathrm{f}}H^\circ = 0\)). Furthermore, because the layers in graphite are held by weak van der Waals forces and slide easily over one another, graphite is soft and slippery—not hard.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The correct statements are that fullerenes are cage-like molecules and graphite is the thermodynamically most stable allotrope of carbon.

answer.text: Graphite is thermodynamically most stable allotrope of carbon
Graphite is slippery and hard and therefore used as a dry lubricant in machines

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQII_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q20 - Structure and bonding in diborane diagram

questiontext.text: Which of the following statements are correct. Answer on the basis of Fig. 11.1.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Diagram and Layout
The diagram shows the structure of diborane (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\)) containing two central boron atoms, four terminal hydrogen atoms, and two bridging hydrogen atoms (one above and one below the plane of the boron and terminal hydrogen atoms).

Step 2: Evaluation
The four terminal \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds are regular two-centre two-electron (\(2c\text{--}2e\)) covalent bonds, and these four terminal hydrogen atoms along with the two boron atoms lie in one plane. The two bridging hydrogen atoms and the two boron atoms lie in a plane perpendicular to the terminal \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) plane. Out of the six total bonds in the diborane framework, the two bridging \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}-\mathrm{B}\) bonds are three-centre two-electron (\(3c\text{--}2e\)) banana bonds, not four.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the correct statements are that the two bridged hydrogen atoms and the two boron atoms lie in one plane, two of the six bonds can be described in terms of \(3\)-centre \(2\)-electron bonds, and the four terminal \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds are two-centre two-electron regular bonds.

answer.text: The two birdged hydrogen atoms and the two boron atoms lie in one plane;
Out of six \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds two bonds can be described in terms of \(3\) centre \(2\)-electron bonds.
Out of six \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds four \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds can be described in terms of \(3\) centre \(2\) electron bonds;
The four terminal \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds are two centre-two electron regular bonds.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MCQII_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q21 - Valid resonance structures of carbon dioxide

questiontext.text: Identify the correct resonance structures of carbon dioxide from the ones given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Carbon dioxide (\(\mathrm{CO}_2\)) has \(16\) valence electrons and is represented as a resonance hybrid of Lewis structures that obey the octet rule and carry appropriate formal charges.

Step 2: Evaluation
In the major neutral resonance contributor \(\mathrm{O} = \mathrm{C} = \mathrm{O}\), carbon forms two double bonds with oxygen, giving every atom a complete octet and zero formal charge. In the minor charge-separated contributors with one single bond and one triple bond, the triple-bonded oxygen atom has \(3\) bonding pairs and \(1\) lone pair, giving it a formal charge of \(6 - 2 - 3 = +1\) (\(\equiv \mathrm{O}^+\)), while the single-bonded oxygen atom carries a formal charge of \(-1\). Placing a \(+1\) formal charge on the single-bonded oxygen atom as in \(\mathrm{O}\equiv \mathrm{C} - \mathrm{O}^{+}\) or omitting the positive charge on the triple-bonded oxygen atom as in \(\mathrm{O} - \mathrm{C}\equiv \mathrm{O}\) violates formal-charge and electron-count rules.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The valid resonance structures among those shown are \(\mathrm{O} = \mathrm{C} = \mathrm{O}\) and \(\mathrm{O - C}\equiv \mathrm{O}^{+}\).

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MATCHING_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MATCHING_Q36 - Matching boron aluminium tin and lead species with properties

questiontext.text: Match the species given in Column I with the properties mentioned in Column II.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The structure, Lewis acidity, and redox behaviour of main-group compounds depend on the central atom's hybridisation, octet completion, and relative stability of oxidation states (including the inert pair effect).

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{BF}_4^-\), boron forms four \(\sigma\)-bonds with four fluoride ions and has no lone pairs, giving it \(sp^3\) hybridisation and a tetrahedral shape. In \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\), aluminium has only six valence electrons (an incomplete octet), so it readily accepts an electron pair and behaves as a Lewis acid. In \(\mathrm{SnO}\), tin is in the \(+2\) oxidation state, which is less stable than its \(+4\) state, so \(\mathrm{SnO}\) can be further oxidised to \(\mathrm{SnO}_2\). In \(\mathrm{PbO}_2\), lead is in the \(+4\) oxidation state; due to the inert pair effect, \(\mathrm{Pb}^{2+}\) is much more stable than \(\mathrm{Pb}^{4+}\), making \(\mathrm{PbO}_2\) a strong oxidising agent.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
\(\mathrm{BF}_4^-\) has a tetrahedral shape; \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) is a Lewis acid; \(\mathrm{SnO}\) can be further oxidised; and \(\mathrm{PbO}_2\) has a central atom in the \(+4\) oxidation state and acts as a strong oxidising agent.

answer.text: Oxidation state of central atom is \(+4\); Strong oxidising agent

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MATCHING_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MATCHING_Q37 - Matching p-block compounds and elements with applications

questiontext.text: Match the species given in Column I with properties given in Column II.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Important \(p\)-block elements and compounds exhibit characteristic bonding features and industrial applications based on their structures and thermal or catalytic properties.

Step 2: Evaluation
Diborane (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\)) contains two three-centre two-electron bridging bonds known as banana bonds. Gallium has a very low melting point (\(303\text{ K}\)) and a very high boiling point (\(2676\text{ K}\)), making it useful for measuring high temperatures. Borax (\(\mathrm{Na}_2\mathrm{B}_4\mathrm{O}_7\cdot 10\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}\)) dissolves metal oxides on heating and is used as a flux for soldering metals. Aluminosilicates such as zeolites are widely used as catalysts in petrochemical industries (for example, ZSM-5). Quartz is a crystalline form of silica (\(\mathrm{SiO}_2\)).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Diborane matches banana bonds; Gallium matches low melting, high boiling, useful for measuring high temperatures; Borax matches used as a flux for soldering metals; Aluminosilicate matches used as catalyst in petrochemical industries; and Quartz matches crystalline form of silica.

answer.text: Low melting, high boiling, useful for measuring high temperatures
Used as a flux for soldering metals
Used as catalyst in petrochemical industries

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_MATCHING_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MATCHING_Q38 - Matching p-block species with central atom hybridisation

questiontext.text: Match the species given in Column I with the hybridisation given in Column II.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The hybridisation of a central atom is determined by its steric number (the number of \(\sigma\)-bonds plus lone pairs around it).

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\left[\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_4\right]^-\), boron forms \(4\) \(\sigma\)-bonds with zero lone pairs, giving \(sp^3\) hybridisation. In \(\left[\mathrm{Al}(\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O})_6\right]^{3+}\), aluminium is surrounded by \(6\) water ligands in an octahedral geometry, corresponding to \(sp^3d^2\) hybridisation. In \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\), each boron atom is surrounded by \(4\) hydrogen atoms (two terminal and two bridging), giving \(sp^3\) hybridisation. In Buckminsterfullerene (\(\mathrm{C}_{60}\)), each carbon atom forms \(3\) \(\sigma\)-bonds and \(1\) \(\pi\)-bond, corresponding to \(sp^2\) hybridisation. In the orthosilicate ion \(\mathrm{SiO}_4^{4-}\), silicon forms \(4\) \(\sigma\)-bonds in a tetrahedral arrangement, giving \(sp^3\) hybridisation. In \(\left[\mathrm{GeCl}_6\right]^{2-}\), germanium is surrounded by \(6\) chloride ligands in an octahedral geometry, giving \(sp^3d^2\) hybridisation.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Boron in \(\left[\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_4\right]^-\), boron in \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\), and silicon in \(\mathrm{SiO}_4^{4-}\) are \(sp^3\) hybridised; carbon in Buckminsterfullerene is \(sp^2\) hybridised; and aluminium in \(\left[\mathrm{Al}(\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O})_6\right]^{3+}\) and germanium in \(\left[\mathrm{GeCl}_6\right]^{2-}\) are \(sp^3d^2\) hybridised.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_ASSERTIONREASON_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q39 - Substitution of silicon by aluminium in silica network

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): If aluminium atoms replace a few silicon atoms in three dimensional network of silicon dioxide, the overall structure acquires a negative charge.

Reason (R) : Aluminium is trivalent while silicon is tetravalent.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In a three-dimensional silicate network (\(\mathrm{SiO}_2\)), each tetravalent silicon atom (\(\mathrm{Si}^{4+}\)) is tetrahedrally coordinated to four oxygen atoms, yielding an electrically neutral framework.

Step 2: Evaluation
Aluminium belongs to Group 13 and is trivalent (\(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\)), whereas silicon belongs to Group 14 and is tetravalent (\(\mathrm{Si}^{4+}\)), so the Reason statement is true. When a trivalent \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\) ion replaces a tetravalent \(\mathrm{Si}^{4+}\) ion in the three-dimensional network of silicon dioxide without changing the oxygen framework, each substitution leaves a net charge deficit of \(+3 - 4 = -1\). Thus, the overall aluminosilicate framework acquires a negative charge, making the Assertion true and the Reason its correct explanation.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

answer.text: Both A and R are correct and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are correct but R is not the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are not correct
A is not correct but R is correct.

name.text: NEETUG_CHEMISTRY_ASSERTIONREASON_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q40 - Water repelling nature of silicones

questiontext.text:
Assertion (A): Silicons are water repelling in nature.

Reason (R) : Silicons are organosilicon polymers, which have \((-\mathrm{R}_2\mathrm{SiO}-)\) as repeating unit.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Silicones are synthetic organosilicon polymers containing \(\mathrm{Si}-\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{Si}\) linkages with organic alkyl or aryl groups attached to silicon.

Step 2: Evaluation
Silicones are indeed water-repelling (hydrophobic) in nature, so Assertion (A) is correct. Furthermore, silicones are organosilicon polymers having \((-\mathrm{R}_2\mathrm{SiO}-)\) as their repeating unit, so Reason (R) is also correct. However, the water-repelling property arises specifically because the polar \(\mathrm{Si}-\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{Si}\) backbone is surrounded by non-polar, hydrophobic alkyl or aryl (\(\mathrm{R}\)) groups—not merely because \((-\mathrm{R}_2\mathrm{SiO}-)\) is the repeating unit.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

answer.text: A and R both are correct and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are correct but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A and R both are not true.
A is not true but R is true.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q01 - Element existing in liquid state for high temperatures

questiontext.text:
The element which exists in liquid state for a wide range of temperature and can be used for measuring high temperature is

যে মৌলটি বিস্তৃত তাপমাত্রার পরিসরে তরল অবস্থায় থাকে এবং উচ্চ তাপমাত্রা পরিমাপের জন্য ব্যবহার করা যায়, তা হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In Group 13, gallium (\(\mathrm{Ga}\)) has an unusually low melting point (\(303\ \mathrm{K}\) or \(29.8^\circ\mathrm{C}\)) due to its crystal structure consisting of discrete \(\mathrm{Ga}_2\) molecules, while its boiling point is very high (\(2676\ \mathrm{K}\)).

Step 2: Evaluation
Because of this extremely wide liquid-state temperature range (\(303\ \mathrm{K}\) to \(2676\ \mathrm{K}\)), gallium remains liquid at high temperatures without evaporating, unlike mercury which boils at \(630\ \mathrm{K}\). Boron (\(\mathrm{B}\)), aluminium (\(\mathrm{Al}\)), and indium (\(\mathrm{In}\)) have much higher melting points (\(2453\ \mathrm{K}\), \(933\ \mathrm{K}\), and \(430\ \mathrm{K}\) respectively).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, gallium (\(\mathrm{Ga}\)) is the element used for measuring high temperatures.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
গ্রুপ ১৩-এর মৌল গ্যালিয়াম (\(\mathrm{Ga}\))-এর কেলাস গঠনে পৃথক \(\mathrm{Ga}_2\) অণু থাকায় এর গলনাঙ্ক অস্বাভাবিকভাবে কম (\(303\ \mathrm{K}\) বা \(29.8^\circ\mathrm{C}\)), কিন্তু এর স্ফুটনাঙ্ক অত্যন্ত বেশি (\(2676\ \mathrm{K}\))।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
তরল অবস্থার এই বিশাল তাপমাত্রা পরিসরের (\(303\ \mathrm{K}\) থেকে \(2676\ \mathrm{K}\)) কারণে গ্যালিয়াম উচ্চ তাপমাত্রায় বাষ্পীভূত না হয়েই তরল থাকে, যেখানে পারদ \(630\ \mathrm{K}\) তাপমাত্রায় ফুটে যায়। বোরন (\(\mathrm{B}\)), অ্যালুমিনিয়াম (\(\mathrm{Al}\)) এবং ইন্ডিয়াম (\(\mathrm{In}\))-এর গলনাঙ্ক অনেক বেশি (যথাক্রমে \(2453\ \mathrm{K}\), \(933\ \mathrm{K}\) এবং \(430\ \mathrm{K}\))।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, উচ্চ তাপমাত্রা পরিমাপের জন্য ব্যবহৃত মৌলটি হলো গ্যালিয়াম (\(\mathrm{Ga}\))।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q02 - Identifying a Lewis acid among halides

questiontext.text:
Which of the following is a Lewis acid?

নিচের কোনটি একটি লুইস অ্যাসিড?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A Lewis acid is an electron-pair acceptor, typically a species with an incomplete octet or vacant orbitals capable of accepting a lone pair of electrons.

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\), the central aluminium atom forms three covalent bonds with chlorine atoms and thus has only \(6\) valence electrons around it. Due to this incomplete octet and the presence of a vacant \(3p\) orbital, \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) readily accepts an electron pair to complete its octet. In contrast, \(\mathrm{MgCl}_2\), \(\mathrm{CaCl}_2\), and \(\mathrm{BaCl}_2\) are predominantly ionic halides of Group 2 elements whose cations already possess a stable noble-gas octet configuration.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) is a Lewis acid.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
লুইস অ্যাসিড হলো এমন একটি প্রজাতি যা ইলেকট্রন জোড় গ্রহণ করতে পারে; সাধারণত এদের অষ্টক অপূর্ণ থাকে বা নিঃসঙ্গ ইলেকট্রন জোড় গ্রহণের জন্য খালি কক্ষক থাকে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
\(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\)-এ কেন্দ্রীয় অ্যালুমিনিয়াম পরমাণু তিনটি ক্লোরিন পরমাণুর সাথে তিনটি সমযোজী বন্ধন গঠন করে, ফলে এর যোজ্যতা কক্ষে মাত্র \(6\)টি ইলেকট্রন থাকে। এই অপূর্ণ অষ্টক এবং একটি খালি \(3p\) কক্ষক থাকার কারণে \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) সহজেই এক জোড়া ইলেকট্রন গ্রহণ করে অষ্টক পূর্ণ করে। অন্যদিকে, \(\mathrm{MgCl}_2\), \(\mathrm{CaCl}_2\) এবং \(\mathrm{BaCl}_2\) হলো গ্রুপ ২ মৌলের আয়নীয় হ্যালাইড, যাদের ক্যাটায়নগুলোর ইতিমধ্যেই স্থিতিশীল নিষ্ক্রিয় গ্যাস অষ্টক বিন্যাস রয়েছে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) একটি লুইস অ্যাসিড।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q03 - Hybridisation and geometry of tetrahydroxo complex

questiontext.text:
The geometry of a complex species can be understood from the knowledge of type of hybridisation of orbitals of central atom. The hybridisation of orbitals of central atom in \(\left[\mathrm{Be}(\mathrm{OH})_{4}\right]^{-}\) and the geometry of the complex are respectively

কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুর কক্ষকের সংকরায়ণের ধরন থেকে একটি জটিল প্রজাতির জ্যামিতিক আকৃতি বোঝা যায়। \(\left[\mathrm{Be}(\mathrm{OH})_{4}\right]^{-}\)-এ কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুর কক্ষকের সংকরায়ণ এবং জটিলটির জ্যামিতি যথাক্রমে হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The hybridisation and geometry of a four-coordinate main-group complex depend on the number of sigma bond pairs and lone pairs around the central atom (using \(s\) and \(p\) valence orbitals).

Step 2: Evaluation
In the given tetrahydroxo species, the central atom is surrounded by four \(\mathrm{OH}^-\) ligands forming four \(\sigma\)-bonds with zero lone pairs. Because the central atom belongs to Period 2, it lacks valence \(d\) orbitals and uses one \(s\) orbital and three \(p\) orbitals to undergo \(sp^3\) hybridisation. Four \(sp^3\) hybrid orbitals directed towards the corners of a regular tetrahedron give a tetrahedral geometry.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Thus, the hybridisation of the central atom is \(sp^3\) and the geometry of the complex is tetrahedral.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
চার-সমন্বয়ী প্রধান গ্রুপের জটিল প্রজাতির সংকরায়ণ এবং জ্যামিতি কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুর চারপাশে থাকা সিগমা বন্ধন জোড় এবং নিঃসঙ্গ ইলেকট্রন জোড়ের সংখ্যার ওপর নির্ভর করে (যেখানে যোজ্যতা স্তরের \(s\) ও \(p\) কক্ষক ব্যবহৃত হয়)।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
প্রদত্ত টেট্রাহাইড্রোক্সো প্রজাতিটিতে কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুটি চারটি \(\mathrm{OH}^-\) লিগ্যান্ড দ্বারা পরিবেষ্টিত হয়ে চারটি \(\sigma\)-বন্ধন গঠন করে এবং কোনো নিঃসঙ্গ ইলেকট্রন জোড় থাকে না। কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুটি দ্বিতীয় পর্যায়ের হওয়ায় এর যোজ্যতা স্তরে কোনো \(d\) কক্ষক নেই; তাই এটি একটি \(s\) এবং তিনটি \(p\) কক্ষক ব্যবহার করে \(sp^3\) সংকরায়ণ ঘটায়। চারটি \(sp^3\) সংকর কক্ষক সুষম চতুস্তলকের চারটি শীর্ষবিন্দুর দিকে বিন্যস্ত থাকে, যা চতুস্তলকীয় জ্যামিতি প্রদান করে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুর সংকরায়ণ হলো \(sp^3\) এবং জটিলটির জ্যামিতি হলো চতুস্তলকীয় (tetrahedral)।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q04 - Acidic nature among Group 13 oxides

questiontext.text:
Which of the following oxides is acidic in nature?

নিচের কোন অক্সাইডটি আম্লিক প্রকৃতির?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In Group 13, metallic character increases down the group from boron to thallium. Consequently, the basicity of their oxides increases and acidity decreases down the group.

Step 2: Evaluation
Boron is a non-metal, so its trioxide \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) is acidic in nature and reacts with bases to form borates. Aluminium oxide (\(\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) and gallium oxide (\(\mathrm{Ga}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) are amphoteric, reacting with both acids and alkalies, whereas indium oxide (\(\mathrm{In}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) is basic.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) is acidic in nature.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
গ্রুপ ১৩-এ বোরন থেকে থ্যালিয়াম পর্যন্ত নিচের দিকে গেলে ধাতব ধর্ম বৃদ্ধি পায়। এর ফলে নিচের দিকে অক্সাইডগুলোর ক্ষারীয় ধর্ম বৃদ্ধি পায় এবং আম্লিক ধর্ম হ্রাস পায়।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
বোরন একটি অধাতু হওয়ায় এর ট্রাইঅক্সাইড \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) আম্লিক প্রকৃতির এবং ক্ষারের সাথে বিক্রিয়া করে বোরেট গঠন করে। অ্যালুমিনিয়াম অক্সাইড (\(\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) এবং গ্যালিয়াম অক্সাইড (\(\mathrm{Ga}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) উভধর্মী (অ্যাসিড ও ক্ষার উভয়ের সাথে বিক্রিয়া করে), যেখানে ইন্ডিয়াম অক্সাইড (\(\mathrm{In}_2\mathrm{O}_3\)) ক্ষারীয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) আম্লিক প্রকৃতির।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q05 - Element unable to form hexafluoro complex

questiontext.text:
The exhibition of highest co-ordination number depends on the availability of vacant orbitals in the central atom. Which of the following elements is not likely to act as central atom in \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\)?

সর্বোচ্চ সমন্বয় সংখ্যা প্রদর্শন কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুতে খালি কক্ষকের উপস্থিতির ওপর নির্ভর করে। নিচের কোন মৌলটি \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\)-এ কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণু হিসেবে কাজ করার সম্ভাবনা নেই?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
To form an octahedral complex ion of the formula \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\) with coordination number \(6\), the central atom must provide six vacant hybrid orbitals (\(sp^3d^2\)), which requires the availability of \(d\) orbitals in its valence shell.

Step 2: Evaluation
Boron (\(\mathrm{B}\)) is a Period 2 element with electronic configuration \(1s^2 2s^2 2p^1\). Its valence shell (\(n=2\)) contains only one \(2s\) and three \(2p\) orbitals, and no \(2d\) orbitals exist. Therefore, boron can expand its coordination number only up to \(4\) (e.g., \([\mathrm{BF}_4]^-\)) and cannot form \([\mathrm{BF}_6]^{3-}\). In contrast, \(\mathrm{Al}\), \(\mathrm{Ga}\), and \(\mathrm{In}\) belong to Periods 3, 4, and 5 respectively, and have vacant \(d\) orbitals in their valence shells to form \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Thus, boron (\(\mathrm{B}\)) is not likely to act as the central atom in \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
\(6\) সমন্বয় সংখ্যাবিশিষ্ট \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\) অষ্টতলকীয় জটিল আয়ন গঠনের জন্য কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণুকে ছয়টি খালি সংকর কক্ষক (\(sp^3d^2\)) সরবরাহ করতে হয়, যার জন্য যোজ্যতা স্তরে \(d\) কক্ষক থাকা আবশ্যক।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
বোরন (\(\mathrm{B}\)) দ্বিতীয় পর্যায়ের মৌল, যার ইলেকট্রন বিন্যাস \(1s^2 2s^2 2p^1\)। এর যোজ্যতা স্তরে (\(n=2\)) কেবল একটি \(2s\) এবং তিনটি \(2p\) কক্ষক রয়েছে, কোনো \(2d\) কক্ষক নেই। তাই বোরন তার সমন্বয় সংখ্যা সর্বোচ্চ \(4\) পর্যন্ত প্রসারিত করতে পারে (যেমন \([\mathrm{BF}_4]^-\)) এবং \([\mathrm{BF}_6]^{3-}\) গঠন করতে পারে না। অন্যদিকে, \(\mathrm{Al}\), \(\mathrm{Ga}\) এবং \(\mathrm{In}\) যথাক্রমে তৃতীয়, চতুর্থ ও পঞ্চম পর্যায়ের মৌল হওয়ায় এদের যোজ্যতা স্তরে খালি \(d\) কক্ষক থাকে, ফলে এরা \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\) গঠন করতে পারে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, বোরন (\(\mathrm{B}\)) \(\mathrm{MF}_6^{3-}\)-এ কেন্দ্রীয় পরমাণু হিসেবে কাজ করতে পারে না।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q06 - Acidic behaviour of boric acid in water

questiontext.text:
Boric acid is an acid because its molecule

বোরিক অ্যাসিড একটি অ্যাসিড কারণ এর অণু

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Boric acid, \(\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3\) (or \(\mathrm{H}_3\mathrm{BO}_3\)), is a weak monobasic Lewis acid rather than a protic Brønsted acid.

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3\), the boron atom has only six valence electrons (incomplete octet) and a vacant \(2p\) orbital. It does not release a proton directly from its own \(\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds. Instead, in aqueous solution, it accepts a lone pair of electrons from a hydroxyl ion (\(\mathrm{OH}^-\)) of water, releasing a proton (\(\mathrm{H}^+\) / \(\mathrm{H}_3\mathrm{O}^+\)):
\[\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3 + 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightleftharpoons [\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_4]^- + \mathrm{H}_3\mathrm{O}^+\]

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, boric acid acts as an acid because its molecule accepts \(\mathrm{OH}^-\) from water, releasing a proton.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
বোরিক অ্যাসিড, \(\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3\) (বা \(\mathrm{H}_3\mathrm{BO}_3\)), প্রোটিক ব্রনস্টেড অ্যাসিড নয় বরং একটি দুর্বল একক্ষারীয় লুইস অ্যাসিড।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
\(\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3\)-এ বোরন পরমাণুর যোজ্যতা স্তরে মাত্র ছয়টি ইলেকট্রন (অপূর্ণ অষ্টক) এবং একটি খালি \(2p\) কক্ষক থাকে। এটি সরাসরি নিজের \(\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{H}\) বন্ধন থেকে প্রোটন ত্যাগ করে না। বরং জলীয় দ্রবণে এটি জলের একটি হাইড্রোক্সিল আয়ন (\(\mathrm{OH}^-\)) থেকে নিঃসঙ্গ ইলেকট্রন জোড় গ্রহণ করে এবং একটি প্রোটন (\(\mathrm{H}^+\) / \(\mathrm{H}_3\mathrm{O}^+\)) মুক্ত করে:
\[\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3 + 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} \rightleftharpoons [\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_4]^- + \mathrm{H}_3\mathrm{O}^+\]

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, বোরিক অ্যাসিড একটি অ্যাসিড কারণ এর অণু জল থেকে \(\mathrm{OH}^-\) গ্রহণ করে প্রোটন মুক্ত করে।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q07 - Order of catenation tendency in Group 14

questiontext.text:
Catenation i.e., linking of similar atoms depends on size and electronic configuration of atoms. The tendency of catenation in Group 14 elements follows the order:

ক্যাটেনেশন অর্থাৎ সমজাতীয় পরমাণুগুলোর পরস্পরের সাথে যুক্ত হওয়ার প্রবণতা পরমাণুর আকার ও ইলেকট্রন বিন্যাসের ওপর নির্ভর করে। গ্রুপ ১৪-এর মৌলগুলোতে ক্যাটেনেশনের প্রবণতা নিচের কোন ক্রম অনুসরণ করে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Catenation is the property of self-linking of atoms of an element through covalent bonds. Its strength depends on the \(\mathrm{M}-\mathrm{M}\) single bond enthalpy, which decreases as atomic size increases down Group 14.

Step 2: Evaluation
Carbon has a very small atomic size and forms exceptionally strong \(\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{C}\) bonds (\(348\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)), giving it a much greater tendency for catenation than silicon (\(\mathrm{Si}-\mathrm{Si} = 297\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)). Moving further down to germanium (\(\mathrm{Ge}-\mathrm{Ge} = 260\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)) and tin (\(\mathrm{Sn}-\mathrm{Sn} = 240\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)), the bond enthalpies decrease further and are nearly comparable.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Hence, the tendency of catenation follows the order \(\mathrm{C} \gg \mathrm{Si} > \mathrm{Ge} \approx \mathrm{Sn}\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
ক্যাটেনেশন হলো কোনো মৌলের পরমাণুগুলোর সমযোজী বন্ধনের মাধ্যমে নিজেদের মধ্যে যুক্ত হয়ে শৃঙ্খল বা বলয় গঠনের ধর্ম। এর মাত্রা \(\mathrm{M}-\mathrm{M}\) একক বন্ধন এনথ্যালপির ওপর নির্ভর করে, যা গ্রুপ ১৪-তে নিচের দিকে পারমাণবিক আকার বৃদ্ধির সাথে সাথে হ্রাস পায়।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
কার্বনের পারমাণবিক আকার অত্যন্ত ছোট হওয়ায় এটি অত্যন্ত শক্তিশালী \(\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{C}\) বন্ধন (\(348\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)) গঠন করে, যার ফলে সিলিকনের (\(\mathrm{Si}-\mathrm{Si} = 297\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)) তুলনায় কার্বনের ক্যাটেনেশন প্রবণতা অনেক বেশি। আরও নিচের দিকে জার্মেনিয়াম (\(\mathrm{Ge}-\mathrm{Ge} = 260\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)) এবং টিন (\(\mathrm{Sn}-\mathrm{Sn} = 240\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\))-এর বন্ধন এনথ্যালপি আরও কমে যায় এবং প্রায় সমান হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, ক্যাটেনেশনের প্রবণতার ক্রম হলো \(\mathrm{C} \gg \mathrm{Si} > \mathrm{Ge} \approx \mathrm{Sn}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q08 - Controlling chain length of silicone polymers

questiontext.text:
Silicon has a strong tendency to form polymers like silicones. The chain length of silicone polymer can be controlled by adding

সিলিকনের সিলিকোন-এর মতো পলিমার গঠনের প্রবল প্রবণতা রয়েছে। সিলিকোন পলিমারের শৃঙ্খলের দৈর্ঘ্য নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা যায় কী যোগ করে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Linear silicone polymers are formed by hydrolysis and condensation of \(\mathrm{Me}_2\mathrm{SiCl}_2\), which produces bifunctional \(\mathrm{Me}_2\mathrm{Si}(\mathrm{OH})_2\) units that extend the chain at both ends.

Step 2: Evaluation
To control and terminate the growing polymer chain, a monofunctional unit is required. Hydrolysis of \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) yields \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiOH}\), which contains only one reactive \(-\mathrm{OH}\) group. When \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiOH}\) condenses with the terminal \(-\mathrm{OH}\) group of a growing silicone chain, it caps the end and prevents further chain growth. In contrast, \(\mathrm{MeSiCl}_3\) causes cross-linking and \(\mathrm{Me}_4\mathrm{Si}\) does not hydrolyse.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the chain length of a silicone polymer can be controlled by adding \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
\(\mathrm{Me}_2\mathrm{SiCl}_2\)-এর আর্দ্রবিশ্লেষণ ও ঘনীভবনের মাধ্যমে রৈখিক সিলিকোন পলিমার গঠিত হয়, যেখানে দ্বি-কার্যকরী \(\mathrm{Me}_2\mathrm{Si}(\mathrm{OH})_2\) একক উভয় প্রান্ত থেকে শৃঙ্খলকে প্রসারিত করে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
বর্ধনশীল পলিমার শৃঙ্খলকে নিয়ন্ত্রণ ও সমাপ্ত করতে একটি এক-কার্যকরী এককের প্রয়োজন হয়। \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\)-এর আর্দ্রবিশ্লেষণে \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiOH}\) উৎপন্ন হয়, যাতে মাত্র একটি সক্রিয় \(-\mathrm{OH}\) মূলক থাকে। যখন \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiOH}\) বর্ধনশীল সিলিকোন শৃঙ্খলের প্রান্তীয় \(-\mathrm{OH}\) মূলকের সাথে ঘনীভূত হয়, তখন সেটি প্রান্তটি বন্ধ করে দেয় এবং শৃঙ্খলের আরও বৃদ্ধি রোধ করে। অন্যদিকে, \(\mathrm{MeSiCl}_3\) ক্রস-লিঙ্কিং ঘটায় এবং \(\mathrm{Me}_4\mathrm{Si}\) আর্দ্রবিশ্লেষিত হয় না।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, \(\mathrm{Me}_3\mathrm{SiCl}\) যোগ করে সিলিকোন পলিমারের শৃঙ্খলের দৈর্ঘ্য নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা যায়।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q09 - Trend in first ionisation enthalpy of Group 13

questiontext.text:
Ionisation enthalpy (\(\Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_{\mathrm{1}}\ \mathrm{kJ}\ \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\)) for the elements of Group 13 follows the order.

গ্রুপ ১৩-এর মৌলগুলোর প্রথম আয়নায়ন এনথ্যালপি (\(\Delta_{\mathrm{i}}\mathrm{H}_{\mathrm{1}}\ \mathrm{kJ}\ \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\)) নিচের কোন ক্রম অনুসরণ করে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Ionisation enthalpy generally decreases down a group due to increasing atomic size, but poor shielding by inner \(d\) and \(f\) electrons can increase effective nuclear charge and reverse the expected trend.

Step 2: Evaluation
From \(\mathrm{B}\) (\(801\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)) to \(\mathrm{Al}\) (\(577\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)), \(\Delta_i H_1\) decreases as expected due to larger size. From \(\mathrm{Al}\) to \(\mathrm{Ga}\) (\(579\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)), the presence of \(10\) poorly shielding \(3d\) electrons increases the effective nuclear charge, making \(\Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{Ga}) > \Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{Al})\). From \(\mathrm{Ga}\) to \(\mathrm{In}\) (\(558\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)), \(\Delta_i H_1\) decreases with increasing size. Finally, from \(\mathrm{In}\) to \(\mathrm{Tl}\) (\(589\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)), poor shielding by \(14\) \(4f\) electrons (lanthanoid contraction) and \(10\) \(5d\) electrons causes \(\Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{Tl}) > \Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{In})\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Thus, the first ionisation enthalpy follows the order \(\mathrm{B} > \mathrm{Al} < \mathrm{Ga} > \mathrm{In} < \mathrm{Tl}\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
সাধারণত শ্রেণি বরাবর নিচের দিকে পারমাণবিক আকার বৃদ্ধির সাথে সাথে আয়নায়ন এনথ্যালপি হ্রাস পায়, তবে অভ্যন্তরীণ \(d\) ও \(f\) ইলেকট্রনের দুর্বল আবরণী প্রভাবের কারণে কার্যকর নিউক্লীয় আধান বৃদ্ধি পেয়ে প্রত্যাশিত ক্রম পরিবর্তিত হতে পারে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
\(\mathrm{B}\) (\(801\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\)) থেকে \(\mathrm{Al}\) (\(577\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\))-এ আকার বৃদ্ধির কারণে \(\Delta_i H_1\) হ্রাস পায়। \(\mathrm{Al}\) থেকে \(\mathrm{Ga}\) (\(579\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\))-এ \(10\)টি \(3d\) ইলেকট্রনের দুর্বল আবরণী প্রভাবের কারণে কার্যকর নিউক্লীয় আধান বেড়ে যায়, ফলে \(\Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{Ga}) > \Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{Al})\) হয়। \(\mathrm{Ga}\) থেকে \(\mathrm{In}\) (\(558\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\))-এ আকার বৃদ্ধির কারণে তা আবার কমে। সবশেষে \(\mathrm{In}\) থেকে \(\mathrm{Tl}\) (\(589\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol}^{-1}\))-এ \(14\)টি \(4f\) ইলেকট্রন (ল্যান্থানয়েড সংকোচন) ও \(10\)টি \(5d\) ইলেকট্রনের দুর্বল আবরণী প্রভাবের কারণে \(\Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{Tl}) > \Delta_i H_1(\mathrm{In})\) হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, প্রথম আয়নায়ন এনথ্যালপির ক্রম হলো \(\mathrm{B} > \mathrm{Al} < \mathrm{Ga} > \mathrm{In} < \mathrm{Tl}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q10 - Spatial arrangement of atoms in diborane

questiontext.text:
In the structure of diborane

ডাইবোরেনের গঠনে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In diborane (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\)), each boron atom is \(sp^3\) hybridised and bonded to two terminal hydrogen atoms and two bridging hydrogen atoms.

Step 2: Evaluation
The four terminal \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) bonds are regular two-centre two-electron (\(2\mathrm{c}-2\mathrm{e}\)) bonds, and these four terminal hydrogen atoms along with the two boron atoms lie in the same plane. The two bridging hydrogen atoms form three-centre two-electron (\(3\mathrm{c}-2\mathrm{e}\)) banana bonds with the two boron atoms, with one bridging hydrogen lying above and the other below this plane, i.e., in a plane perpendicular to the plane of the two boron and four terminal hydrogen atoms.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, in diborane, \(2\) boron atoms and \(4\) terminal hydrogen atoms lie in the same plane, while \(2\) bridging hydrogen atoms lie in the perpendicular plane.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
ডাইবোরেন (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\))-এ প্রতিটি বোরন পরমাণু \(sp^3\) সংকরায়িত এবং দুটি প্রান্তীয় হাইড্রোজেন ও দুটি সেতু-বন্ধনকারী (bridging) হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণুর সাথে যুক্ত থাকে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
চারটি প্রান্তীয় \(\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{H}\) বন্ধন হলো সাধারণ দ্বি-কেন্দ্রিক দ্বি-ইলেকট্রন (\(2\mathrm{c}-2\mathrm{e}\)) বন্ধন এবং এই চারটি প্রান্তীয় হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণু ও দুটি বোরন পরমাণু একই সমতলে অবস্থান করে। দুটি সেতু-বন্ধনকারী হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণু দুটি বোরন পরমাণুর সাথে ত্রি-কেন্দ্রিক দ্বি-ইলেকট্রন (\(3\mathrm{c}-2\mathrm{e}\)) কলা-বন্ধন গঠন করে; এদের একটি এই সমতলের ওপরে এবং অন্যটি নিচে অর্থাৎ লম্ব সমতলে অবস্থান করে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, ডাইবোরেনে \(2\)টি বোরন পরমাণু এবং \(4\)টি প্রান্তীয় হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণু একই সমতলে থাকে এবং \(2\)টি সেতু-বন্ধনকারী হাইড্রোজেন পরমাণু লম্ব সমতলে অবস্থান করে।

answer.text: All hydrogen atoms lie in one plane and boron atoms lie in a plane perpendicular to this plane.
2 boron atoms and 4 terminal hydrogen atoms lie in the same plane and 2 bridging hydrogen atoms lie in the perpendicular plane.
4 bridging hydrogen atoms and boron atoms lie in one plane and two terminal hydrogen atoms lie in a plane perpendicular to this plane.
All the atoms are in the same plane.

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q11 - Preparation of diborane and borazine

questiontext.text:
A compound X, of boron reacts with \(\mathrm{NH}_3\) on heating to give another compound Y which is called inorganic benzene. The compound X can be prepared by treating \(\mathrm{BF}_3\) with Lithium aluminium hydride. The compounds X and Y are represented by the formulas.

বোরনের একটি যৌগ X উত্তপ্ত অবস্থায় \(\mathrm{NH}_3\)-এর সাথে বিক্রিয়া করে অপর একটি যৌগ Y উৎপন্ন করে, যাকে অজৈব বেঞ্জিন বলা হয়। \(\mathrm{BF}_3\)-কে লিথিয়াম অ্যালুমিনিয়াম হাইড্রাইডের সাথে বিক্রিয়া করিয়ে X যৌগটি প্রস্তুত করা যায়। X এবং Y যৌগ দুটি নিচের কোন সংকেত দ্বারা সূচিত হয়?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Reduction of boron trifluoride (\(\mathrm{BF}_3\)) with lithium aluminium hydride (\(\mathrm{LiAlH}_4\)) yields diborane, and reaction of diborane with ammonia at high temperature yields borazine (inorganic benzene).

Step 2: Step-by-Step Working
1. Preparation of compound X:
\[4\mathrm{BF}_3 + 3\mathrm{LiAlH}_4 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6 + 3\mathrm{LiF} + 3\mathrm{AlF}_3\]
Thus, X is diborane (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\)).
2. Conversion of X to Y on heating with \(\mathrm{NH}_3\):
\[3\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6 + 6\mathrm{NH}_3 \xrightarrow{\Delta} 2\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6 + 12\mathrm{H}_2\]
Thus, Y is borazine (\(\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6\)), which is isoelectronic and isostructural with benzene and hence called inorganic benzene.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, compounds X and Y are \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\) and \(\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6\) respectively.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
লিথিয়াম অ্যালুমিনিয়াম হাইড্রাইড (\(\mathrm{LiAlH}_4\)) দ্বারা বোরন ট্রাইফ্লুওরাইড (\(\mathrm{BF}_3\))-এর বিজারণে ডাইবোরেন উৎপন্ন হয় এবং উচ্চ তাপমাত্রায় অ্যামোনিয়ার সাথে ডাইবোরেনের বিক্রিয়ায় বোরাজিন (অজৈব বেঞ্জিন) গঠিত হয়।

ধাপ ২: ধাপে ধাপে গণনা ও বিক্রিয়া
১. X যৌগের প্রস্তুতি:
\[4\mathrm{BF}_3 + 3\mathrm{LiAlH}_4 \rightarrow 2\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6 + 3\mathrm{LiF} + 3\mathrm{AlF}_3\]
সুতরাং, X হলো ডাইবোরেন (\(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\))।
২. \(\mathrm{NH}_3\)-এর সাথে উত্তপ্ত করে X থেকে Y উৎপাদন:
\[3\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6 + 6\mathrm{NH}_3 \xrightarrow{\Delta} 2\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6 + 12\mathrm{H}_2\]
সুতরাং, Y হলো বোরাজিন (\(\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6\)), যা বেঞ্জিনের সাথে সমইলেকট্রনীয় এবং সমগঠনবিশিষ্ট হওয়ায় একে অজৈব বেঞ্জিন বলা হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, X এবং Y যৌগ দুটি যথাক্রমে \(\mathrm{B}_2\mathrm{H}_6\) এবং \(\mathrm{B}_3\mathrm{N}_3\mathrm{H}_6\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q12 - Constituent element of piezoelectric quartz

questiontext.text:
Quartz is extensively used as a piezoelectric material, it contains

কোয়ার্টজ পিয়েজোইলেকট্রিক পদার্থ হিসেবে ব্যাপকভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়, এতে থাকে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Quartz is one of the crystalline forms of silica (silicon dioxide, \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\)), a three-dimensional covalent network solid.

Step 2: Evaluation
Since quartz is composed of \(\mathrm{SiO}_4\) tetrahedral units linked together in a network of \(\mathrm{Si}-\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{Si}\) bonds, its constituent elements are silicon (\(\mathrm{Si}\)) and oxygen (\(\mathrm{O}\)).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, quartz contains silicon (\(\mathrm{Si}\)).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
কোয়ার্টজ হলো সিলিকার (সিলিকন ডাইঅক্সাইড, \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\)) একটি কেলাসিত রূপ, যা একটি ত্রিমাত্রিক সমযোজী জালক কঠিন।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
যেহেতু কোয়ার্টজ \(\mathrm{Si}-\mathrm{O}-\mathrm{Si}\) বন্ধনের জালকে যুক্ত \(\mathrm{SiO}_4\) চতুস্তলকীয় একক দ্বারা গঠিত, তাই এর উপাদান মৌলগুলো হলো সিলিকন (\(\mathrm{Si}\)) এবং অক্সিজেন (\(\mathrm{O}\))।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, কোয়ার্টজে সিলিকন (\(\mathrm{Si}\)) থাকে।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q13 - Most commonly used reducing agent among halides

questiontext.text:
The most commonly used reducing agent is

সবচেয়ে সাধারণভাবে ব্যবহৃত বিজারক দ্রব্যটি হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A reducing agent readily undergoes oxidation by losing electrons to achieve a more stable higher oxidation state. In Group 14, the \(+4\) oxidation state is more stable for tin (\(\mathrm{Sn}\)), whereas the \(+2\) oxidation state is more stable for lead (\(\mathrm{Pb}\)) due to the inert pair effect.

Step 2: Evaluation
In \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\), tin is in the \(+2\) oxidation state, which readily oxidises to the more stable \(+4\) state (\(\mathrm{Sn}^{2+} \rightarrow \mathrm{Sn}^{4+} + 2e^-\)), making \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\) a strong and commonly used reducing agent. In contrast, \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\) in \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\) and \(\mathrm{Sn}^{4+}\) in \(\mathrm{SnCl}_4\) are already in their maximum oxidation states and cannot be oxidised further, while \(\mathrm{Pb}^{2+}\) in \(\mathrm{PbCl}_2\) is very stable and resists oxidation to \(\mathrm{Pb}^{4+}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\) is the most commonly used reducing agent.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
একটি বিজারক দ্রব্য সহজেই ইলেকট্রন বর্জন করে জারিত হয় এবং অধিকতর স্থিতিশীল উচ্চতর জারণ অবস্থা অর্জন করে। গ্রুপ ১৪-তে টিনের (\(\mathrm{Sn}\)) জন্য \(+4\) জারণ অবস্থা অধিক স্থিতিশীল, যেখানে নিষ্ক্রিয় জোড় প্রভাবের কারণে সিসার (\(\mathrm{Pb}\)) জন্য \(+2\) জারণ অবস্থা অধিক স্থিতিশীল।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
\(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\)-এ টিন \(+2\) জারণ অবস্থায় থাকে, যা সহজেই জারিত হয়ে অধিক স্থিতিশীল \(+4\) অবস্থায় পরিণত হয় (\(\mathrm{Sn}^{2+} \rightarrow \mathrm{Sn}^{4+} + 2e^-\)); ফলে \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\) একটি শক্তিশালী ও বহুল ব্যবহৃত বিজারক। অন্যদিকে, \(\mathrm{AlCl}_3\)-এ \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\) এবং \(\mathrm{SnCl}_4\)-এ \(\mathrm{Sn}^{4+}\) ইতিমধ্যেই তাদের সর্বোচ্চ জারণ অবস্থায় থাকায় আরও জারিত হতে পারে না, আর \(\mathrm{PbCl}_2\)-এ \(\mathrm{Pb}^{2+}\) অত্যন্ত স্থিতিশীল হওয়ায় \(\mathrm{Pb}^{4+}\)-এ জারিত হতে চায় না।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, \(\mathrm{SnCl}_2\) হলো সবচেয়ে সাধারণভাবে ব্যবহৃত বিজারক দ্রব্য।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q14 - Chemical composition of dry ice

questiontext.text:
Dry ice is

শুষ্ক বরফ (Dry ice) হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Dry ice is the common name for the solid form of carbon dioxide (\(\mathrm{CO}_2\)).

Step 2: Evaluation
Solid \(\mathrm{CO}_2\) is called dry ice because at atmospheric pressure it sublimates directly from the solid state to the gaseous state without melting into a liquid, leaving no wet residue. It is obtained by rapid cooling of liquified \(\mathrm{CO}_2\) and is used as a refrigerant.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, dry ice is solid \(\mathrm{CO}_2\).

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
শুষ্ক বরফ হলো কঠিন কার্বন ডাইঅক্সাইড (\(\mathrm{CO}_2\))-এর প্রচলিত নাম।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
কঠিন \(\mathrm{CO}_2\)-কে শুষ্ক বরফ বলা হয় কারণ বায়ুমণ্ডলীয় চাপে এটি তরলে পরিণত না হয়ে সরাসরি কঠিন অবস্থা থেকে গ্যাসীয় অবস্থায় ঊর্ধ্বপাতিত হয়, ফলে কোনো ভেজা অবশেষ থাকে না। তরল \(\mathrm{CO}_2\)-কে দ্রুত শীতল করে এটি তৈরি করা হয় এবং হিমায়ক হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, শুষ্ক বরফ হলো কঠিন \(\mathrm{CO}_2\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q15 - Group-wise oxides present in Portland cement

questiontext.text:
Cement, the important building material is a mixture of oxides of several elements. Besides calcium, iron and sulphur, oxides of elements of which of the group (s) are present in the mixture?

সিমেন্ট, একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নির্মাণ সামগ্রী, যা বিভিন্ন মৌলের অক্সাইডের মিশ্রণ। ক্যালসিয়াম, আয়রন ও সালফার ছাড়াও মিশ্রণটিতে নিচের কোন গ্রুপ(সমূহ)-এর মৌলের অক্সাইড উপস্থিত থাকে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Portland cement is manufactured by heating limestone and clay, resulting in a mixture of metal and non-metal oxides.

Step 2: Evaluation
The average composition of Portland cement is \(\mathrm{CaO}\) (\(50\text{–}60\%\)), \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\) (\(20\text{–}25\%\)), \(\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) (\(5\text{–}10\%\)), \(\mathrm{MgO}\) (\(2\text{–}3\%\)), \(\mathrm{Fe}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) (\(1\text{–}2\%\)), and \(\mathrm{SO}_3\) (\(1\text{–}2\%\)). Besides calcium, iron, and sulphur, it contains magnesium (\(\mathrm{Mg}\) from Group 2), aluminium (\(\mathrm{Al}\) from Group 13), and silicon (\(\mathrm{Si}\) from Group 14).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, oxides of elements belonging to groups \(2\), \(13\), and \(14\) are present in the mixture.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
চুনাপাথর ও কাদামাটি উত্তপ্ত করে পোর্টল্যান্ড সিমেন্ট তৈরি করা হয়, যা বিভিন্ন ধাতব ও অধাতব অক্সাইডের মিশ্রণ।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
পোর্টল্যান্ড সিমেন্টের গড় সংযুতি হলো \(\mathrm{CaO}\) (\(50\text{–}60\%\)), \(\mathrm{SiO}_2\) (\(20\text{–}25\%\)), \(\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) (\(5\text{–}10\%\)), \(\mathrm{MgO}\) (\(2\text{–}3\%\)), \(\mathrm{Fe}_2\mathrm{O}_3\) (\(1\text{–}2\%\)) এবং \(\mathrm{SO}_3\) (\(1\text{–}2\%\))। ক্যালসিয়াম, আয়রন ও সালফার ছাড়াও এতে ম্যাগনেসিয়াম (গ্রুপ ২-এর \(\mathrm{Mg}\)), অ্যালুমিনিয়াম (গ্রুপ ১৩-এর \(\mathrm{Al}\)) এবং সিলিকন (গ্রুপ ১৪-এর \(\mathrm{Si}\))-এর অক্সাইড উপস্থিত থাকে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, মিশ্রণটিতে গ্রুপ \(2\), \(13\) এবং \(14\)-এর মৌলগুলোর অক্সাইড উপস্থিত থাকে।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_PBLOCKELEMENTS_MCQ_Q16 - Reasons for smaller atomic radius of gallium

questiontext.text:
The reason for small radius of Ga compared to Al is

Al-এর তুলনায় Ga-এর পারমাণবিক ব্যাসার্ধ ছোট হওয়ার কারণ হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Atomic radius depends on both the principal quantum number of the outermost shell and the effective nuclear charge (\(Z_{\text{eff}}\)) experienced by the valence electrons.

Step 2: Evaluation
Gallium (\(\mathrm{Ga}, Z = 31\)) has \(10\) electrons in its inner \(3d\) subshell, whereas aluminium (\(\mathrm{Al}, Z = 13\)) has no \(d\) electrons. Because \(d\) (and \(f\)) orbitals have diffuse shapes and poor screening (shielding) effect, they do not effectively shield the outer \(4s\) and \(4p\) electrons from the increased nuclear charge. As a result, the increase in nuclear charge outweighs the addition of a new shell, pulling the valence electrons closer and making the atomic radius of \(\mathrm{Ga}\) (\(135\ \mathrm{pm}\)) smaller than that of \(\mathrm{Al}\) (\(143\ \mathrm{pm}\)).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the small radius of \(\mathrm{Ga}\) compared to \(\mathrm{Al}\) is due to the poor screening effect of \(d\) and \(f\) orbitals and the increase in nuclear charge.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
পারমাণবিক ব্যাসার্ধ সর্ববহিঃস্থ কক্ষের মুখ্য কোয়ান্টাম সংখ্যা এবং যোজ্যতা ইলেকট্রনগুলোর ওপর ক্রিয়াশীল কার্যকর নিউক্লীয় আধান (\(Z_{\text{eff}}\))—উভয়ের ওপরই নির্ভর করে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
